verdict.rationale: Kimi documents an official desktop app, Kimi Code Desktop, where the agent can open a local project folder, read and edit files, and run commands. Nothing in the evidence shows OS-level global shortcuts or any ability to see what is on the user's screen, so only the 'official desktop app' part of the story is covered. Missing for 10: OS-level/global keyboard shortcuts, screen-content access (screenshot or screen-share awareness), a general-purpose assistant desktop app beyond the coding tool, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can use an official desktop app with OS-level shortcuts and access to what is on my screen

citations.quote: Open a local project folder in Kimi Code Desktop and let the Agent read code, edit files, run commands, and verify results through conversation.
